CORE MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #5
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 12.5
   B. 6
   C. 25
   D. 5

2. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 4
   C. 5
   D. 8

3. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)

   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 43

4. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)

   B. 49
   C. 2
   D. 1

5. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)

   C. 22
   D. 14

7. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)

   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x

8. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 31
   D. 2

9. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)

   B. 1/4

   A. 1
   B. 25
   C. 1
   D. 2

23. Solve for x: x + 5 = 17. (1 mark)
